text:
maria: quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-path autotune, mixtral-8b seen a small but consistent QA quality drop on long-context tests (seq>2048). failing evals attached to thread.
raj: seen the post-tuning perf numbers, curious if it's numeric drift or kv layout. can you paste the repro prompt?
maria: repro prompt (shortened): 'Given the following long meeting transcript... what was action item #3?' fails to reference the correct item ~18% more often post-change.
sophie: are we sure it's the kernel change and not quant toggle? last deploy also flipped `quantize_autotoggle: true` for that model profile.
maria: we ran eval with quant off and still saw a smaller but present delta (~6%). so kernel path looks suspect.
kevin: profiling snippet from canary trace:
```
kernel_path: tiled_attention
p50_decode: 22ms -> 14ms
p90_decode: 118ms -> 72ms
kv_hits: 99.2% -> 98.7%
evict_count: +3 per request
notes: tiled_attn uses packed kv layout (stride change)
```
ana: eviction jump could shift KV offsets causing past key/value misalignment for head dims. that could change attention weighting numerics and hurt long-range QA.
raj: good point. tiled_attn packs KV into 128-byte aligned tiles; older plain_attn used contiguous per-head layout. small changes in index math combined with ropecenter scaling might create rounding differences.
maria: i compared logits diff for the same prompt (float32 compare) — per-token KL increase is tiny but accumulates over long prefix, leads to higher divergence at answer time.
sophie: action: run deterministic run with `RUNTIME_DETERMINISM=1` and `KV_CHECKSUM=1` to verify layout integrity.
kevin: i'll spin up a bisect across kernel variants (plain, tiled, tiled-v2, fallback) + quant toggle combos. will also dump KV offsets.
deploy-bot: canary update: mixtral-8b@canary -> kernel-selector:v3 deployed to 3 hosts (note: traffic ramping)
maria: until bisect completes i propose rollback of kernel-selector:v3 for mixtral-8b canary to avoid further eval regressions. quality matters more than the 1.6x p90 perf win.
raj: agree. i'll prepare a minimal rollback plan: revert kernel-selector config, add telemetry for KV eviction delta and per-head norm diff.
ana: also add a small eval slice focusing on repeated-token prefixes and rope-scaled prompts — that's where divergence spikes.
sophie: schedule 30m postmortem after bisect, include perf graphs and per-head attention heatmaps.
kevin: notes for release: document the tiled_attn layout, ropecenter interaction, and a checklist for kernel swaps (determinism check, kv checksum, eval slice run).
maria: thanks all — assigning follow-ups: raj bisect, kevin rollback, ana add eval slices, sophie run heatmaps. ping if blocked :thumbsup:
